title: European Commission: Poland, Sweden, Belgium, Estonia and Cyprus receive more than €9.8 billion under NextGenerationEU
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 01 Oct 2026 The European Commission has disbursed today more than €9.8 billion to Poland, Sweden, Belgium, Estonia and Cyprus under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

title: European Commission: Member States submit their final payment requests under the Recovery and Resilience Facility
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 01 Oct 2026 All Member States of the EU have now submitted to the European Commission their final payment requests under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU, by the deadline of 30 September 2026.
